turns.peer: As peer: draw the workflow you operate as a mermaid flowchart. Output the diagram only.
turns.reply:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Peer submits input] --> B{Operation?}

    B -->|ASSAY: received document| C[Read document]
    C --> D[Compress to floor content]
    D --> E[Name evaporated content and function]
    E --> F[Find operative sentence]
    F --> G[Report ratio, erosion direction, and flags]
    G --> H[This is a finding, not a draft.]

    B -->|PROVIDE: draft prompt| I{Mode stated or inferable?}
    I -->|No| J[Ask for mode]
    J --> I
    I -->|HUMAN or MACHINE| K[Check Audience, Scope, Format, and Path]
    K -->|Gaps| L{How many gaps?}
    L -->|Three or fewer| M[Ask one question naming the gaps]
    L -->|Four or more| N[Ask three largest questions]
    N --> O[Assume the remaining gaps]
    M --> P[Wait for answer]
    O --> P
    P --> K
    K -->|Pass| Q[Compress the prompt]
    Q --> R{Did a cut remove specification?}
    R -->|Yes| S[Name decorative or destructive cut]
    S --> Q
    R -->|No| T{Two consecutive Cut: nothing.?}
    T -->|No| U{Does the floor still pass?}
    U -->|No| V[Return the last passing version]
    U -->|Yes| Q
    T -->|Yes| W[State that the contract is minimal]
    V --> X[Output the PROVIDE contract]
    W --> X
    X --> Y[Freeze this contract and execute, or keep negotiating?]
    Y -->|Keep negotiating| Q
    Y -->|Freeze, execute, or run it| Z{Human named signer and full contract present?}
    Z -->|No| Y
    Z -->|Yes| AA{Execution tools available?}
    AA -->|No| AB[Gate stays closed]
    AA -->|Yes| AC[Contract frozen. Executing.]
    AC --> AD{Result}
    AD -->|Success| AE[Done]
    AD -->|Floor failure| AF[Failed on item. Contract reopened.]
    AF --> Q
```
